summary: Dragonheir is introducing the Starweave Echo event as part of the upcoming anniversary celebration, allowing players to convert duplicate Legendary Soul Imprints into Starweave Fragments. Each imprint exchanges for 12 Starweave Fragments, which can be spent in the Temporal Corridor to claim desired Legendary heroes. Skratch advises prioritizing hard-to-obtain exclusive support heroes over standard damage dealers. Additionally, players should participate in the web-based daily dice roll event to accumulate rewards such as Wyrmarrow and Auric Tokens, claimable starting September 15.
